t:
This product is supplied without battery and charger.

3-mode hammer drill with vibration control due to the 4-spring mounted floating gearbox. High speed drilling performance at more than 90 holes (10mm dia. x 80mm) per charge. 'Rotation Stop' for light chiselling in plaster, tiles and render and 'Impact Stop' for rotary only drilling in wood and metal. Brushless motor for extreme runtime and reduced maintenance.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
